pt.L: Voltem à fortaleza, \q prisioneiros da esperança; \q ainda hoje declaro: \q o dobro te restituirei.
pt.B: Voltem para a fortaleza, \q prisioneiros que têm esperança! \q Ainda hoje anuncio \q que te devolverei o dobro.
pt.R: Prisioneiros que ainda têm esperança, \q voltem para o lugar onde vão estar seguros! \q Hoje eu te prometo \q que vou te devolver o dobro do que perdeste.

decisions.choice: return to the stronghold: come home to the place of safety
decisions.reason: The stronghold is a fortified place where people are safe. Here it is Zion, or the LORD himself, who is called his people's stronghold in Joel 4:16 and Nahum 1:7. The prisoners in the pit of verse 11 are called to come home.

decisions.choice: prisoners of hope: captives who have reason to hope
decisions.reason: The captives are not without hope, because the LORD has promised to free them. Hope here is the confident waiting for what God will do (Jeremiah 29:11; 31:17).

decisions.choice: I will restore to you double: twice as much as was lost
decisions.reason: A double share was the portion of the firstborn (Deuteronomy 21:17). Isaiah 61:7 promises a double share in place of shame, and Isaiah 40:2 says that Jerusalem has received double for her sins; Job received back twice what he had lost (Job 42:10). The LORD's restoring will be more than full.

decisions.choice: the place where you will be safe; twice as much as you lost (R)
decisions.reason: Readable explains "stronghold" (m1) and "double" (m3), and puts the address to the prisoners first.

decisions.choice: "Revenez" (plural) to the prisoners, "je te rendrai" (singular) to Zion
decisions.reason: French switches number with the Hebrew, as the term sheet asks.

decisions.choice: "Vuelvan" with plural_you; "te devolveré" (L, B)
decisions.reason: The Hebrew turns from the prisoners (plural) back to Zion (singular, "to you"); L and B follow it. R keeps the plural throughout, since it speaks only to the prisoners.

decisions.choice: "nitakurudishia" (L, B), singular
decisions.reason: The Hebrew "to you" is singular, Zion addressed again, while "prisoners" is plural; Literal and Balanced keep the shift. Readable uses the plural throughout.

decisions.choice: Voltem (the prisoners); te restituirei (Zion)
decisions.reason: The call is plural, to the prisoners, so "voltem"; the promise of double (m3) goes back to Zion in the feminine singular of verse 11, so "te" ("tu"), as the Hebrew has it.

source.text: כִּֽי־דָרַ֨כְתִּי לִ֜י יְהוּדָ֗ה קֶ֚שֶׁת מִלֵּ֣אתִי אֶפְרַ֔יִם וְעוֹרַרְתִּ֤י בָנַ֨יִךְ֙ צִיּ֔וֹן עַל־בָּנַ֖יִךְ יָוָ֑ן וְשַׂמְתִּ֖יךְ כְּחֶ֥רֶב גִּבּֽוֹר׃

records.literal_gloss: For I will bend for myself Judah [as] a bow; I will fill [it with] Ephraim, and I will rouse your sons, Zion, against your sons, Greece; and I will make you like [the] sword of a warrior.

en.L: For I will bend Judah for {{deity_pronoun:myself|Myself}} [as a bow]; I will fill the bow [with] Ephraim; \q and I will rouse your sons, Zion, \q against your sons, Greece, \q and I will make you like a warrior's sword.
en.B: For I will bend Judah as {{deity_pronoun:my|My}} bow and set Ephraim on it as {{deity_pronoun:my|My}} arrow. \q I will rouse your sons, Zion, \q against your sons, Greece, \q and make you like a warrior's sword.
en.R: I will use Judah as {{deity_pronoun:my|My}} bow and Ephraim as {{deity_pronoun:my|My}} arrow. \q People of Zion, I will send your sons into battle \q against the sons of Greece. \q I will make you like a soldier's sword.

fr.L: Car je bande Juda pour {{deity_pronoun:moi|Moi}} [comme un arc], je remplis [l’arc avec] Éphraïm ; \q et je réveillerai tes fils, Sion, \q contre tes fils, Grèce, \q et je ferai de toi comme l’épée d’un guerrier.
fr.B: Car je tendrai Juda comme {{deity_pronoun:mon|Mon}} arc et j’y placerai Éphraïm comme {{deity_pronoun:ma|Ma}} flèche. \q Je réveillerai tes fils, Sion, \q contre tes fils, Grèce, \q et je ferai de toi comme l’épée d’un guerrier.
fr.R: Je {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}} servirai de Juda comme de {{deity_pronoun:mon|Mon}} arc et d’Éphraïm comme de {{deity_pronoun:ma|Ma}} flèche. \q Peuple de Sion, j’enverrai tes fils au combat \q contre les fils de la Grèce. \q Je ferai de toi comme l’épée d’un soldat.

es.L: Porque he tensado a Judá para {{deity_pronoun:mí|Mí}} [como arco]; he llenado el arco [con] Efraín; \q y levantaré a tus hijos, oh Sion, \q contra tus hijos, oh Grecia, \q y te haré como espada de guerrero.
es.B: Porque tensaré a Judá como {{deity_pronoun:mi|Mi}} arco y pondré a Efraín en él como {{deity_pronoun:mi|Mi}} flecha. \q Levantaré a tus hijos, Sion, \q contra tus hijos, Grecia, \q y te haré como la espada de un guerrero.
es.R: Usaré a Judá como {{deity_pronoun:mi|Mi}} arco y a Efraín como {{deity_pronoun:mi|Mi}} flecha. \q Pueblo de Sion, enviaré a tus hijos a la batalla \q contra los hijos de Grecia. \q Te haré como la espada de un soldado.

vi.L: Vì {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} sẽ giương Giu-đa cho {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} [như cây cung]; {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} sẽ lắp Ép-ra-im [làm tên]; \q {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} sẽ giục các con trai ngươi, hỡi Si-ôn, \q chống lại các con trai ngươi, hỡi Hy Lạp, \q và {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} sẽ làm cho ngươi như gươm của dũng sĩ.
vi.B: Vì {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} sẽ giương Giu-đa làm cung của {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}}, và lắp Ép-ra-im làm mũi tên của {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}}. \q Hỡi Si-ôn, {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} sẽ giục các con trai của con đứng lên \q chống lại các con trai của ngươi, hỡi Hy Lạp, \q và {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} sẽ làm cho con như thanh gươm của dũng sĩ.
vi.R: Ta sẽ dùng Giu-đa làm cây cung của {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}}, và Ép-ra-im làm mũi tên của {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}}. \q Hỡi dân Si-ôn, {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} sẽ sai các con trai của các con ra trận \q chống lại con cái của Hy Lạp. \q Ta sẽ làm cho các con như thanh gươm của người lính.

sw.L: Kwa maana nitampinda Yuda kwa ajili {{deity_pronoun:yangu|Yangu}} [kama upinde]; nitaujaza upinde [kwa] Efraimu; \q {{deity_pronoun:nami|Nami}} nitawaamsha wana wako, ee Sayuni, \q dhidi ya wana wako, ee Ugiriki, \q {{deity_pronoun:nami|Nami}} nitakufanya kama upanga wa shujaa.
sw.B: Kwa maana nitampinda Yuda kama upinde {{deity_pronoun:wangu|Wangu}} na kumweka Efraimu juu yake kama mshale {{deity_pronoun:wangu|Wangu}}. \q Nitawaamsha wana wako, ee Sayuni, \q dhidi ya wana wako, ee Ugiriki, \q na kukufanya kama upanga wa shujaa.
sw.R: Nitamtumia Yuda kama upinde {{deity_pronoun:wangu|Wangu}} na Efraimu kama mshale {{deity_pronoun:wangu|Wangu}}. \q Enyi watu wa Sayuni, nitawapeleka wana wenu vitani \q dhidi ya wana wa Ugiriki. \q Nitawafanya kama upanga wa askari.

ko.L: 내가 나를 위하여 유다를 [활처럼] 당기고, 에브라임으로 활을 채웠다. \q 시온아, 내가 네 아들들을 일으켜 \q 그리스야, 네 아들들을 치게 하고, \q 너를 용사의 칼처럼 만들겠다.
ko.B: 내가 유다를 내 활로 당기고, 에브라임을 내 화살로 그 활에 메우겠다. \q 시온아, 내가 네 아들들을 일으켜 \q 그리스야, 네 아들들을 치게 하고, \q 너를 용사의 칼처럼 만들겠다.
ko.R: 나는 유다를 내 활로 쓰고, 에브라임을 내 화살로 쓰겠다. \q 시온 백성아, 내가 너희 젊은이들을 싸움터로 보내어 \q 그리스의 젊은이들과 싸우게 하겠다. \q 내가 너희를 군인의 칼처럼 만들겠다.

pt.L: Porque curvarei Judá para {{deity_pronoun:mim|Mim}} [como arco]; encherei o arco [com] Efraim; \q e despertarei os teus filhos, Sião, \q contra os teus filhos, Grécia, \q e te farei como a espada de um guerreiro.
pt.B: Porque curvarei Judá como o {{deity_pronoun:meu|Meu}} arco e porei Efraim nele como a {{deity_pronoun:minha|Minha}} flecha. \q Despertarei os teus filhos, Sião, \q contra os teus filhos, Grécia, \q e farei de ti a espada de um guerreiro.
pt.R: Vou usar Judá como o {{deity_pronoun:meu|Meu}} arco e Efraim como a {{deity_pronoun:minha|Minha}} flecha. \q Povo de Sião, vou mandar os teus filhos para a guerra \q contra os filhos da Grécia. \q Vou fazer de ti uma espada de soldado.

decisions.choice: bend Judah as a bow, fill it with Ephraim: Judah and Ephraim are the LORD's weapons
decisions.reason: A bow was "bent" (strung and drawn) to shoot, and "filled" when the arrow was set on it. The LORD himself is the warrior; Judah is his bow and Ephraim his arrow. The two kingdoms fight together again as one people, under the LORD's hand.

decisions.choice: Greece: the Greeks (Javan), the peoples of the far west
decisions.reason: The Hebrew name is Javan, the Ionians, used for the Greeks (Genesis 10:2-5; Isaiah 66:19; Joel 4:6; Daniel 8:21). In Zechariah's day Greek cities were at war with Persia; later, Alexander the Great and the kingdoms that followed him ruled the land of Israel. Readers who date these chapters later see the Greek kingdoms here; others take Greece as the distant enemy of the day. The oracle does not say.

decisions.choice: your sons, Zion ... your sons, Greece: two cities addressed in turn
decisions.reason: The LORD speaks first to Zion and then to Greece, setting the people of each against the other. The last line returns to Zion: "I will make you like a warrior's sword".

decisions.choice: as my bow ... as my arrow (B, R)
decisions.reason: Balanced and Readable name the bow and the arrow, which Literal brackets, so that the picture of the bow being drawn (m1) is clear. The LORD speaks of himself, so "my" takes the deity_pronoun setting.

decisions.choice: I will send your sons into battle against the sons of Greece; a soldier's sword (R)
decisions.reason: Readable says plainly what "rouse your sons against your sons" means, and puts the address to Zion first.

decisions.choice: "Grecia"
decisions.reason: The English names Greece at every level, so Spanish says "Grecia"; the meaning decision gives the Hebrew Javan.

decisions.choice: "그리스" for Javan
decisions.reason: As the term sheet's names [Acts]; the meaning decision explains that Javan is the Greeks.

decisions.choice: Zion is "con" (B) / "các con" (R), Greece is "ngươi"
decisions.reason: God speaks tenderly to his people and sternly to the enemy; Vietnamese pronouns can carry the contrast the Hebrew draws by addressing the two in turn. Greece (Yavan) is "Hy Lạp", as the English and Daniel.

decisions.choice: "Grèce" at every level
decisions.reason: The English says Greece at every level here; the term sheet keeps "Javan" only where the English does.

decisions.choice: "Ugiriki" (Greece)
decisions.reason: The term sheet uses "Ugiriki" where the English says Greece, as Acts 20:2; "Yavani" is kept for places where the English keeps Javan.

decisions.choice: Grécia
decisions.reason: Javan (m2) is "Grécia", the name Daniel 8:21 has for the Greeks in Portuguese, as the English says "Greece"; Zion and Greece are each spoken to as one, with "tu".

source.text: וַֽיהוָה֙ עֲלֵיהֶ֣ם יֵֽרָאֶ֔ה וְיָצָ֥א כַבָּרָ֖ק חִצּ֑וֹ וַֽאדֹנָ֤י יְהֹוִה֙ בַּשּׁוֹפָ֣ר יִתְקָ֔ע וְהָלַ֖ךְ בְּסַעֲר֥וֹת תֵּימָֽן׃

records.literal_gloss: And Yahweh over them will appear, and will go out like lightning his arrow; and [the] Lord Yahweh on the horn will blow, and he will go in [the] storms of [the] south.

en.L: And {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} will appear over them, \q and {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} arrow will go out like lightning; \q and the Lord {{divine_name:GOD|Yahweh}} will blow on the trumpet \q and march in the storms of the south.
en.B: Then {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} will appear above them, \q and {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} arrow will flash out like lightning. \q The Lord {{divine_name:GOD|Yahweh}} will sound the ram's horn \q and march out in the storm winds from the south.
en.R: {{divine_name:The LORD|Yahweh}} will appear above {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} people. \q His arrows will flash like lightning. \q The Lord {{divine_name:GOD|Yahweh}} will blow the trumpet. \q He will march out in the storms from the south.

fr.L: Et {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} apparaîtra au-dessus d’eux, \q et {{deity_pronoun:sa|Sa}} flèche partira comme l’éclair ; \q et le Seigneur {{divine_name:DIEU|Yahvé}} sonnera du cor \q et s’avancera dans les tempêtes du midi.
fr.B: Alors {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} apparaîtra au-dessus d’eux, \q et {{deity_pronoun:sa|Sa}} flèche jaillira comme l’éclair. \q Le Seigneur {{divine_name:DIEU|Yahvé}} sonnera du cor \q et s’avancera dans les ouragans du sud.
fr.R: {{divine_name:Le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} apparaîtra au-dessus de {{deity_pronoun:son|Son}} peuple. \q Ses flèches brilleront comme des éclairs. \q Le Seigneur {{divine_name:DIEU|Yahvé}} sonnera de la trompette. \q Il {{deity_pronoun:s’|S’}}avancera dans les tempêtes venues du sud.

es.L: Y {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} aparecerá sobre ellos, \q y {{deity_pronoun:su|Su}} flecha saldrá como relámpago; \q y el Señor {{divine_name:DIOS|Yahvé}} tocará la trompeta \q y marchará en los torbellinos del sur.
es.B: Entonces {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} aparecerá sobre ellos, \q y {{deity_pronoun:su|Su}} flecha saldrá como un relámpago. \q El Señor {{divine_name:DIOS|Yahvé}} tocará el cuerno de carnero \q y avanzará en las tormentas del sur.
es.R: {{divine_name:El SEÑOR|Yahvé}} aparecerá sobre {{deity_pronoun:su|Su}} pueblo. \q Sus flechas brillarán como relámpagos. \q El Señor {{divine_name:DIOS|Yahvé}} tocará la trompeta. \q Avanzará en las tormentas que vienen del sur.

vi.L: Bấy giờ {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} sẽ hiện ra trên họ, \q và mũi tên {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} sẽ phóng ra như chớp; \q Chúa là {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} sẽ thổi kèn \q và tiến bước trong những cơn bão phương nam.
vi.B: Bấy giờ {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} sẽ hiện ra phía trên họ, \q và mũi tên {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} sẽ lóe ra như tia chớp. \q Chúa là {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} sẽ thổi tù và \q và tiến ra giữa những cơn gió bão từ phương nam.
vi.R: {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} sẽ hiện ra phía trên dân {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}. \q Các mũi tên của {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} sẽ lóe sáng như tia chớp. \q Chúa là {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} sẽ thổi kèn. \q Ngài sẽ tiến ra trong những cơn bão từ phương nam.

sw.L: Na {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} ataonekana juu yao, \q na mshale {{deity_pronoun:wake|Wake}} utatoka kama umeme; \q naye Bwana {{divine_name:MUNGU|Yahwe}} atapiga baragumu, \q na kwenda katika tufani za kusini.
sw.B: Ndipo {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} atatokea juu yao, \q na mshale {{deity_pronoun:wake|Wake}} utamulika kama umeme. \q Bwana {{divine_name:MUNGU|Yahwe}} atapiga baragumu \q na kutoka katika pepo za dhoruba za kusini.
sw.R: {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} atatokea juu ya watu {{deity_pronoun:wake|Wake}}. \q Mishale {{deity_pronoun:yake|Yake}} itamulika kama umeme. \q Bwana {{divine_name:MUNGU|Yahwe}} atapiga baragumu. \q Atatoka akitembea katika dhoruba kutoka kusini.

ko.L: {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서 그들 위에 나타나시고, \q 그분의 화살이 번개처럼 나갈 것이다. \q 주 {{divine_name:하나님|야훼}}께서 나팔을 부시고 \q 남쪽의 폭풍을 타고 나아가실 것이다.
ko.B: 그때 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서 그들 위에 나타나시고, \q 그분의 화살이 번개처럼 번쩍일 것이다. \q 주 {{divine_name:하나님|야훼}}께서 숫양 뿔 나팔을 부시고 \q 남쪽에서 불어오는 폭풍 속에서 진군하실 것이다.
ko.R: {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서 그분의 백성 위에 나타나실 것이다. \q 그분의 화살이 번개처럼 번쩍일 것이다. \q 주 {{divine_name:하나님|야훼}}께서 나팔을 부실 것이다. \q 그분은 남쪽에서 불어오는 폭풍 속에서 진군하실 것이다.

pt.L: E {{divine_name:o SENHOR|Javé}} aparecerá sobre eles, \q e a {{deity_pronoun:sua|Sua}} flecha sairá como o relâmpago; \q e o Senhor {{divine_name:DEUS|Javé}} tocará o chifre de carneiro \q e marchará nas tempestades do sul.
pt.B: Então {{divine_name:o SENHOR|Javé}} aparecerá acima deles, \q e a {{deity_pronoun:sua|Sua}} flecha brilhará como o relâmpago. \q O Senhor {{divine_name:DEUS|Javé}} tocará o chifre de carneiro \q e marchará nos ventos tempestuosos do sul.
pt.R: {{divine_name:O SENHOR|Javé}} vai aparecer acima do {{deity_pronoun:seu|Seu}} povo. \q As {{deity_pronoun:suas|Suas}} flechas vão brilhar como relâmpagos. \q O Senhor {{divine_name:DEUS|Javé}} vai tocar a trombeta. \q Ele vai marchar nas tempestades que vêm do sul.

decisions.choice: the LORD will appear: he comes as a warrior, in the storm
decisions.reason: The prophets and psalms picture the LORD coming to fight for his people in a storm: his arrows are lightning and his voice is thunder (Psalm 18:8-16; 77:18-19; Habakkuk 3:3-11). Here he appears above his people as they fight (verse 13), and the battle is his.

decisions.choice: blow on the trumpet: the signal for battle
decisions.reason: The ram's horn was blown to call to battle and to sound the attack (Judges 3:27; Joshua 6:5). Here it is the Lord GOD himself who sounds it.

decisions.choice: the storms of the south: the LORD comes from the southern desert, from Sinai
decisions.reason: The south (Teman) is the land toward Edom and Sinai. The old poems tell of the LORD marching from there to help his people (Deuteronomy 33:2; Judges 5:4; Habakkuk 3:3). Storms from the southern desert were fierce (Isaiah 21:1).

decisions.choice: trumpet (L, R); ram's horn (B)
decisions.reason: The shofar is a "trumpet" at Literal and Readable and a "ram's horn" at Balanced, as in Isaiah. Readable says "his people" for "them" and "arrows" for the single arrow, since lightning flashes again and again.

decisions.choice: "trompeta" (L, R); "cuerno de carnero" (B)
decisions.reason: Shofar follows the Spanish prophets at each level.

decisions.choice: "baragumu" for the shofar at every level; "Bwana MUNGU" for Adonai YHWH
decisions.reason: As the settled Swahili choice for the shofar in the prophets, and the term sheet's "Bwana MUNGU" with the span on MUNGU only.

decisions.choice: "주 {{divine_name:하나님|야훼}}께서"; "나팔" (L, R), "숫양 뿔 나팔" (B)
decisions.reason: Lord GOD is "주 {{divine_name:하나님|야훼}}" with "께서", which reads after both forms (term sheet section 0); shofar follows the term sheet and the English levels.

decisions.choice: "Chúa là CHÚA" for Adonai YHWH; shofar "kèn" (L, R) / "tù và" (B)
decisions.reason: The term sheet's forms: "Chúa" plain and outside the span, as Isaiah 28:16; the shofar as settled in the Isaiah note.

decisions.choice: shofar "cor" (L, B), "trompette" (R)
decisions.reason: As the term sheet; the English has "trumpet" at Literal and "ram's horn" at Balanced.

decisions.choice: o chifre de carneiro (L, B); a trombeta (R); o Senhor DEUS
decisions.reason: The shofar is "o chifre de carneiro" at Literal and Balanced, the Portuguese the Old Testament gives it (Exodus 19:13; Jeremiah 4:5), and "a trombeta" at Readable, where the English Readable says "trumpet". Adonai with the divine name is "o Senhor DEUS", as the Old Testament terms set it.

source.text: יְהוָ֣ה צְבָאוֹת֮ יָגֵ֣ן עֲלֵיהֶם֒ וְאָכְל֗וּ וְכָֽבְשׁוּ֙ אַבְנֵי־קֶ֔לַע וְשָׁת֥וּ הָמ֖וּ כְּמוֹ־יָ֑יִן וּמָֽלְאוּ֙ כַּמִּזְרָ֔ק כְּזָוִיּ֖וֹת מִזְבֵּֽחַ׃

records.literal_gloss: Yahweh of hosts will defend them, and they will devour and tread down [the] stones of [the] sling, and they will drink [and] roar like wine, and they will be full like the bowl, like [the] corners of [the] altar.

en.L: {{divine_name:The LORD|Yahweh}} of hosts will defend them, \q and they will devour and tread down the sling stones; \q and they will drink, they will be loud as [with] wine, \q and they will be full like the bowl, \q like the corners of [the] altar.
en.B: {{divine_name:The LORD|Yahweh}} of Armies will shield them. \q They will devour and trample the sling stones; \q they will drink and roar as if with wine. \q They will be filled like a sacrificial bowl, \q drenched like the corners of the altar.
en.R: {{divine_name:The LORD|Yahweh}} of Armies will protect them. \q They will destroy their enemies and trample on their sling stones. \q They will drink and shout as if they were full of wine. \q They will be full like the bowl used to splash blood on the altar, \q like the corners of the altar that are wet with blood.

fr.L: {{divine_name:Le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} des armées les protégera, \q et ils dévoreront et piétineront les pierres de fronde ; \q et ils boiront, ils seront bruyants comme [sous l’effet du] vin, \q et ils seront remplis comme la coupe, \q comme les coins de [l’]autel.
fr.B: {{divine_name:Le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} des armées sera leur bouclier. \q Ils dévoreront et piétineront les pierres de fronde ; \q ils boiront et crieront comme s’ils avaient bu du vin. \q Ils seront remplis comme une coupe pour les sacrifices, \q inondés comme les coins de l’autel.
fr.R: {{divine_name:Le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} des armées les protégera. \q Ils détruiront leurs ennemis et piétineront leurs pierres de fronde. \q Ils boiront et crieront comme s’ils étaient pleins de vin. \q Ils seront remplis comme la coupe qui sert à verser le sang sur l’autel, \q comme les coins de l’autel, couverts de sang.

es.L: {{divine_name:El SEÑOR|Yahvé}} de los ejércitos los defenderá, \q y ellos devorarán y pisotearán las piedras de la honda; \q y beberán, harán estruendo como [con] vino, \q y se llenarán como el tazón, \q como las esquinas del altar.
es.B: {{divine_name:El SEÑOR|Yahvé}} de los Ejércitos los protegerá como un escudo. \q Devorarán y pisotearán las piedras de la honda; \q beberán y gritarán como si estuvieran llenos de vino. \q Estarán llenos como el tazón de los sacrificios, \q empapados como las esquinas del altar.
es.R: {{divine_name:El SEÑOR|Yahvé}} de los Ejércitos los protegerá. \q Destruirán a sus enemigos y pisotearán las piedras de sus hondas. \q Beberán y gritarán como si estuvieran llenos de vino. \q Estarán llenos como el tazón que se usa para rociar la sangre sobre el altar, \q como las esquinas del altar mojadas de sangre.

vi.L: {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} Vạn Quân sẽ che chở họ, \q họ sẽ ăn nuốt và giày đạp những viên đá ná; \q họ sẽ uống và la hét ầm ĩ như [say] rượu, \q họ sẽ đầy tràn như cái chậu, \q như các góc bàn thờ.
vi.B: {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} Vạn Quân sẽ che chở họ. \q Họ sẽ ăn nuốt và giày đạp những viên đá ná; \q họ sẽ uống và la hét như người say rượu. \q Họ sẽ đầy tràn như chậu dâng tế lễ, \q đẫm ướt như các góc bàn thờ.
vi.R: {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} Vạn Quân sẽ bảo vệ họ. \q Họ sẽ tiêu diệt kẻ thù và giày đạp những viên đá ná của chúng. \q Họ sẽ uống và reo hò như người say rượu. \q Họ sẽ đầy tràn như cái chậu dùng để rảy máu trên bàn thờ, \q như các góc bàn thờ ướt đẫm máu.

sw.L: {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} wa majeshi atawalinda, \q nao watakula na kukanyaga mawe ya teo; \q nao watakunywa, watapiga kelele kama [kwa] divai, \q nao watajaa kama bakuli, \q kama pembe za madhabahu.
sw.B: {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} wa majeshi atawakinga. \q Watawala na kuyakanyaga mawe ya teo; \q watakunywa na kunguruma kana kwamba kwa divai. \q Watajazwa kama bakuli la dhabihu, \q wakiloa kama pembe za madhabahu.
sw.R: {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} wa majeshi atawalinda. \q Watawaangamiza adui zao na kuyakanyaga mawe yao ya teo. \q Watakunywa na kupiga kelele kana kwamba wamejaa divai. \q Watajaa kama bakuli linalotumiwa kunyunyiza damu madhabahuni, \q kama pembe za madhabahu zilizolowa damu.

ko.L: 만군의 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서 그들을 보호하실 것이니, \q 그들이 삼키고 물맷돌을 밟을 것이다. \q 그들이 마시고 포도주에 [취한 듯] 소리칠 것이며, \q 대접처럼 가득 차고 \q 제단의 모퉁이처럼 [젖을 것이다].
ko.B: 만군의 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서 그들을 방패처럼 지켜 주실 것이다. \q 그들은 원수를 삼키고 물맷돌을 짓밟을 것이다. \q 그들은 마시고 포도주에 취한 듯 소리칠 것이다. \q 제물의 피를 담는 대접처럼 가득 차고, \q 제단 모퉁이처럼 흠뻑 젖을 것이다.
ko.R: 하늘의 군대를 거느리신 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서 그들을 지켜 주실 것이다. \q 그들은 원수들을 무찌르고, 원수들이 던진 물맷돌을 짓밟을 것이다. \q 그들은 마시고 포도주에 취한 사람들처럼 소리칠 것이다. \q 그들은 제단에 피를 뿌리는 대접처럼 가득 찰 것이다. \q 피에 젖은 제단 모퉁이처럼 될 것이다.

pt.L: {{divine_name:O SENHOR|Javé}} dos Exércitos os defenderá, \q e eles devorarão e pisarão as pedras da funda; \q e beberão, e farão barulho como [com] vinho, \q e ficarão cheios como a bacia, \q como os cantos do altar.
pt.B: {{divine_name:O SENHOR|Javé}} dos Exércitos os protegerá como um escudo. \q Eles devorarão e pisarão as pedras das fundas; \q beberão e gritarão como se estivessem cheios de vinho. \q Ficarão cheios como uma bacia de sacrifício, \q encharcados como os cantos do altar.
pt.R: {{divine_name:O SENHOR|Javé}} dos Exércitos vai proteger o seu povo. \q Eles vão destruir os inimigos e pisar nas pedras que eles atiram com as fundas. \q Vão beber e gritar como se estivessem cheios de vinho. \q Vão ficar cheios como a bacia que se usa para espalhar sangue no altar, \q como os cantos do altar molhados de sangue.

decisions.choice: defend them: shield them, as a city is shielded
decisions.reason: The verb is from the word for a shield. The LORD covers his people as he promised to cover Jerusalem (Isaiah 31:5; 37:35). The same verb is used of the LORD shielding Jerusalem in 12:8.

decisions.choice: devour and tread down the sling stones: the people overcome their enemies and their weapons
alternatives: they will tread down [their enemies like] sling stones
their sling stones will devour and subdue [the enemy]
decisions.reason: The Hebrew is brief. It most likely means that the people eat up their enemies, as a lion devours its prey (Numbers 23:24), and trample on the stones flung at them by the enemy's slingers, which cannot harm them. Some read it as the people treading down their enemies as if they were sling stones, or as the people's own sling stones overpowering the enemy. In every reading the people win the battle with the LORD's help.

decisions.choice: drink and roar as with wine; full like the bowl, like the corners of the altar: a victory feast pictured as a sacrifice
decisions.reason: The bowl is the basin used at the altar to catch the blood of the sacrifices and splash it against the altar's corners (Exodus 27:3; Leviticus 4:7). The victorious people are pictured as drinking deep, loud as with wine, and as filled like those bowls, as soaked as the altar's corners. The picture is of the blood of the enemy, as in Isaiah 34:6-7 and Ezekiel 39:17-19. The Septuagint makes the drinking explicit: "they will drink their blood like wine".

decisions.choice: the LORD of Armies; a sacrificial bowl; drenched (B); the bowl used to splash blood on the altar (R)
decisions.reason: "The LORD of hosts" is "the LORD of Armies" at Balanced and Readable, as in Isaiah. Balanced and Readable say what the bowl was for (m3). Readable supplies "their enemies" as the object of "devour", which the Hebrew leaves out (m2).

decisions.choice: "el tazón" (L); "el tazón de los sacrificios" (B); "el tazón que se usa para rociar la sangre" (R)
decisions.reason: The bowl is the basin for the blood of sacrifices; B and R make that plain, as the English does.

source.text: וְֽהוֹשִׁיעָ֞ם יְהוָ֧ה אֱלֹהֵיהֶ֛ם בַּיּ֥וֹם הַה֖וּא כְּצֹ֣אן עַמּ֑וֹ כִּ֚י אַבְנֵי־נֵ֔זֶר מִֽתְנוֹסְס֖וֹת עַל־אַדְמָתֽוֹ׃

records.literal_gloss: And will save them Yahweh their God on that day, as [the] flock of his people; for stones of a crown [they will be], sparkling over his land.

en.L: And {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} their God will save them in that day like a flock, {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} people; \q for [they will be] the stones of a crown, \q sparkling over {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} land.
en.B: On that day {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} their God will save them, for they are {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} people, {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} flock. \q Like jewels in a crown \q they will sparkle over {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} land.
en.R: At that time {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} their God will rescue them, because they are {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} people, the flock {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} cares for. \q They will shine in {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} land \q like jewels in a crown.

fr.L: Et {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} leur Dieu les sauvera en ce jour-là comme un troupeau, {{deity_pronoun:son|Son}} peuple ; \q car [ils seront] les pierres d’une couronne, \q étincelant sur {{deity_pronoun:sa|Sa}} terre.
fr.B: Ce jour-là, {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} leur Dieu les sauvera, car ils sont {{deity_pronoun:son|Son}} peuple, {{deity_pronoun:son|Son}} troupeau. \q Comme les pierres précieuses d’une couronne, \q ils étincelleront sur {{deity_pronoun:sa|Sa}} terre.
fr.R: En ce temps-là, {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} leur Dieu les délivrera, parce qu’ils sont {{deity_pronoun:son|Son}} peuple, le troupeau dont {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} prend soin. \q Ils brilleront sur {{deity_pronoun:sa|Sa}} terre \q comme les pierres précieuses d’une couronne.

es.L: Y {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} su Dios los salvará en aquel día como al rebaño de {{deity_pronoun:su|Su}} pueblo; \q porque [serán] piedras de una corona, \q que brillan sobre {{deity_pronoun:su|Su}} tierra.
es.B: Aquel día {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} su Dios los salvará, porque son {{deity_pronoun:su|Su}} pueblo, {{deity_pronoun:su|Su}} rebaño. \q Como joyas de una corona \q brillarán sobre {{deity_pronoun:su|Su}} tierra.
es.R: En ese tiempo {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} su Dios los rescatará, porque son {{deity_pronoun:su|Su}} pueblo, el rebaño que {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}} cuida. \q Brillarán en {{deity_pronoun:su|Su}} tierra \q como joyas de una corona.

vi.L: Trong ngày ấy, {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} Đức Chúa Trời của họ sẽ giải cứu họ như bầy chiên, là dân của {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}; \q vì [họ sẽ là] những viên ngọc của mão miện, \q lấp lánh trên đất của {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}.
vi.B: Vào ngày ấy, {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} Đức Chúa Trời của họ sẽ cứu họ, vì họ là dân {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}, là bầy chiên của {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}. \q Như ngọc quý trên mão miện, \q họ sẽ lấp lánh trên đất của {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}.
vi.R: Vào lúc ấy, {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} Đức Chúa Trời của họ sẽ giải cứu họ, vì họ là dân {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}, là bầy chiên {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} chăm sóc. \q Họ sẽ chiếu sáng trên đất của {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} \q như những viên ngọc trên mão miện.

sw.L: Na {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} Mungu wao atawaokoa katika siku ile kama kundi, watu {{deity_pronoun:wake|Wake}}; \q kwa maana [watakuwa] mawe ya taji, \q yanayometameta juu ya nchi {{deity_pronoun:yake|Yake}}.
sw.B: Siku hiyo {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} Mungu wao atawaokoa, kwa maana wao ni watu {{deity_pronoun:wake|Wake}}, kundi {{deity_pronoun:lake|Lake}}. \q Kama vito katika taji \q watametameta juu ya nchi {{deity_pronoun:yake|Yake}}.
sw.R: Wakati huo {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} Mungu wao atawaokoa, kwa sababu wao ni watu {{deity_pronoun:wake|Wake}}, kundi ambalo {{deity_pronoun:yeye|Yeye}} analitunza. \q Watang'aa katika nchi {{deity_pronoun:yake|Yake}} \q kama vito katika taji.

ko.L: 그날에 그들의 하나님 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서 그들을 그분의 백성의 양 떼처럼 구원하실 것이니, \q 그들이 면류관의 보석들처럼 \q 그분의 땅 위에서 반짝일 것이다.
ko.B: 그날에 그들의 하나님 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서 그들을 구원하실 것이다. 그들은 그분의 백성이요, 그분의 양 떼이기 때문이다. \q 그들은 면류관에 박힌 보석들처럼 \q 그분의 땅에서 반짝일 것이다.
ko.R: 그때 그들의 하나님 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서 그들을 구해 주실 것이다. 그들은 그분의 백성이요, 그분께서 돌보시는 양 떼이기 때문이다. \q 그들은 그분의 땅에서 \q 왕관에 박힌 보석들처럼 빛날 것이다.

pt.L: E {{divine_name:o SENHOR|Javé}}, o Deus deles, os salvará naquele dia como um rebanho, o {{deity_pronoun:seu|Seu}} povo; \q porque [serão] as pedras de uma coroa, \q cintilando sobre a {{deity_pronoun:sua|Sua}} terra.
pt.B: Naquele dia, {{divine_name:o SENHOR|Javé}}, o Deus deles, os salvará, porque são o {{deity_pronoun:seu|Seu}} povo, o {{deity_pronoun:seu|Seu}} rebanho. \q Como joias numa coroa, \q eles brilharão sobre a {{deity_pronoun:sua|Sua}} terra.
pt.R: Naquele dia, {{divine_name:o SENHOR|Javé}}, o Deus deles, vai salvá-los, porque eles são o {{deity_pronoun:seu|Seu}} povo, o rebanho de que {{deity_pronoun:ele|Ele}} cuida. \q Eles vão brilhar na {{deity_pronoun:sua|Sua}} terra \q como joias numa coroa.

decisions.choice: as the flock of his people: the LORD as shepherd of his people
decisions.reason: The people are the LORD's flock, and he is their shepherd (Psalm 23:1; 80:2; Ezekiel 34:11-16). The picture prepares for chapters 10-11 and 13:7, where the shepherds of the people are judged and the LORD gathers his flock.

decisions.choice: stones of a crown, sparkling over his land: the people will be the land's treasure
decisions.reason: The jewels of a royal crown catch the light. The people saved by the LORD will be like jewels set on his land, the crown of his work. Isaiah 62:3 calls Zion "a crown of beauty in the LORD's hand". The verb for "sparkling" is rare and may also mean "raised up like a banner".

decisions.choice: in that day (L); On that day (B); At that time (R)
decisions.reason: The phrase follows the wording set in Isaiah. Balanced and Readable put it first, as English does; Readable says "the flock he cares for" and puts the comparison with jewels after the verb.

decisions.choice: "en ce jour-là" (L), "ce jour-là" (B), "en ce temps-là" (R)
decisions.reason: As the term sheet.

decisions.choice: "en aquel día" (L); "aquel día" (B); "en ese tiempo" (R)
decisions.reason: "In that day" follows the Spanish prophets at each level, through Zechariah 9-14.

decisions.choice: "Trong ngày ấy" / "Vào ngày ấy" / "Vào lúc ấy"
decisions.reason: The term sheet's three-level wording for "in that day".

decisions.choice: "katika siku ile" (L); "siku hiyo" (B); "wakati huo" (R)
decisions.reason: The term sheet's wording for "in that day", as Isaiah. Recorded once for Zechariah; the same wording stands in 2:15, 3:10 and chapters 12-14.

decisions.choice: naquele dia (every level)
decisions.reason: "Naquele dia" at every level, as set for the whole book at 2:15, where the English Readable says "At that time".

source.text: כִּ֥י מַה־טּוּב֖וֹ וּמַה־יָפְי֑וֹ דָּגָן֙ בַּֽחוּרִ֔ים וְתִיר֖וֹשׁ יְנוֹבֵ֥ב בְּתֻלֽוֹת׃

records.literal_gloss: For how [great is] its goodness, and how [great is] its beauty! Grain will make young men flourish, and new wine young women.

en.L: For how great [is] its goodness, and how great its beauty! \q Grain will make [the] young men thrive, \q and new wine the young women.
en.B: How good and how lovely they will be! \q The young men will flourish on grain, \q and the young women on new wine.
en.R: How good and beautiful they will be! \q The young men will grow strong on plenty of grain, \q and the young women on plenty of new wine.

fr.L: Car que sa bonté [est grande], et que sa beauté [est grande] ! \q Le blé fera prospérer les jeunes gens, \q et le vin nouveau les jeunes filles.
fr.B: Qu’ils seront bons et beaux ! \q Les jeunes gens s’épanouiront grâce au blé, \q et les jeunes filles grâce au vin nouveau.
fr.R: Comme ils seront bons et beaux ! \q Les jeunes hommes deviendront forts grâce à tout ce blé, \q et les jeunes filles grâce à tout ce vin nouveau.

es.L: ¡Porque cuán grande [es] su bondad, y cuán grande su hermosura! \q El grano hará florecer a [los] jóvenes, \q y el vino nuevo a las doncellas.
es.B: ¡Qué buenos y qué hermosos serán! \q Los jóvenes florecerán con el grano, \q y las muchachas con el vino nuevo.
es.R: ¡Qué buenos y hermosos serán! \q Los jóvenes crecerán fuertes con el grano abundante, \q y las muchachas con el vino nuevo abundante.

vi.L: Vì sự tốt lành của nó lớn biết bao, và vẻ đẹp của nó lớn biết bao! \q Ngũ cốc sẽ làm cho trai tráng mạnh mẽ, \q và rượu mới làm cho thiếu nữ [xinh tươi].
vi.B: Họ sẽ tốt đẹp và xinh tươi biết bao! \q Trai tráng sẽ lớn mạnh nhờ ngũ cốc, \q và thiếu nữ xinh tươi nhờ rượu mới.
vi.R: Họ sẽ tốt đẹp và xinh tươi biết bao! \q Các chàng trai sẽ lớn mạnh nhờ có thật nhiều lúa, \q và các cô gái nhờ có thật nhiều rượu mới.

sw.L: Kwa maana wema wake [ni] mkuu kama nini, na uzuri wake kama nini! \q Nafaka itawastawisha vijana wa kiume, \q na divai mpya wasichana.
sw.B: Watakuwa wema na wazuri kama nini! \q Vijana wa kiume watastawi kwa nafaka, \q na wasichana kwa divai mpya.
sw.R: Watakuwa wema na wazuri sana! \q Vijana wa kiume watakua na nguvu kwa nafaka nyingi, \q na wasichana kwa divai mpya nyingi.

ko.L: 참으로 그 좋음이 얼마나 크고, 그 아름다움이 얼마나 큰가! \q 곡식은 청년들을, \q 새 포도주는 처녀들을 자라게 할 것이다.
ko.B: 그들이 얼마나 좋고, 얼마나 아름다울까! \q 청년들은 곡식으로 튼튼해지고, \q 처녀들은 새 포도주로 피어날 것이다.
ko.R: 그들이 얼마나 좋고 아름다울까! \q 젊은 남자들은 넉넉한 곡식을 먹고 튼튼하게 자라고, \q 젊은 여자들은 넉넉한 새 포도주를 마시고 튼튼하게 자랄 것이다.

pt.L: Porque quão grande [é] a sua bondade, e quão grande a sua beleza! \q O trigo fará prosperar os rapazes, \q e o vinho novo, as moças.
pt.B: Como eles serão bons e belos! \q Os rapazes crescerão fortes com o trigo, \q e as moças, com o vinho novo.
pt.R: Como eles vão ser bons e bonitos! \q Os rapazes vão ficar fortes com muito trigo, \q e as moças, com muito vinho novo.

decisions.choice: how great its goodness and its beauty: the goodness and beauty of the LORD's people
alternatives: how great is his goodness, and how great his beauty (the LORD's)
decisions.reason: The Hebrew says "his goodness ... his beauty". It is read here of the people, the flock and the jewels of verse 16, to whom the next lines turn: young men and young women thriving on the harvest. It may also be read of the LORD: "how great is his goodness, how great his beauty!" (compare Psalm 27:4; 31:20). The word "beauty" is used mostly of people and things, not of God, which favors the first reading.

decisions.choice: grain and new wine: the harvest of a land at peace
decisions.reason: Grain and new wine are the chief harvests of the land and signs of the LORD's blessing (Deuteronomy 7:13; Hosea 2:24; Joel 2:19). In place of war, the young men and women of the land grow strong on its plenty.

decisions.choice: its goodness (L); they will be (B, R); thrive (B); grow strong on plenty of (R)
decisions.reason: Literal keeps the Hebrew's singular as "its", so that it can refer to the flock or the land; Balanced and Readable say "they", the people (m1). Balanced and Readable put the young men and women first.
